title: Figure 8: Witness sketch of black-furred dog-like creature with pig-like snout
description: Pen sketch of a large, shaggy, upright-sitting animal with pointed ears, a broad pig-like snout and thick front legs, with the handwritten annotation "black fur" beside it. The caption reads "Figure 8 - Dog-like creature witnessed by [redacted]. Illustration by [redacted] on April 21, 2010," with names redacted under 1843(a)(2). The text describes a black-furred creature the size of a "big man" that appeared hostile, and mentions howling-sound recordings the witness linked to "Skinwalkers" and "Shape shifters."
